description: Set a file on input[type=file] from the server filesystem via DataTransfer (max 200 MB; over 6 MB it travels in pieces). Keys and credentials (~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.gnupg, .env*, *.pem, *.key, id_*…) are refused, and a --read-root on the server limits the readable tree: the call fails with an error, nothing is read.

path.description: Absolute path on the server machine; keys and credentials (~/.ssh, .env, *.pem) refused

selector.description: The file input to fill; ">>>" pierces shadow DOM

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

name: upload_file
